title: startedAt uses z.coerce.date() at the API boundary instead of the repo's strict date parse
plain: Neu du lieu ngay bat dau bi loi hoac thieu, he thong co the van tao ke hoach voi ngay sai (vi du nam 1970) thay vi bao loi ro rang cho nguoi dung.

title: KhungTao keeps the sheet's open state in useState, unlike every other create sheet in the app
plain: Khong the gui lien ket mo san cac hop thoai tao moi nay cho dong nghiep, va neu nguoi dung lo tai lai trang khi dang mo hop thoai thi hop thoai se dong lai.

title: Step row in the template editor adds its own bordered surface with the wrong radius
plain: Khung quanh moi buoc trong man soan khuon co goc bo hoi khac voi cac khung khac trong san pham — mot chi tiet nho ve mat hinh anh.

title: Tunable values sit inline, and the client's day limit disagrees with the server's
plain: Neu ai do nhap so ngay rat lon (vi du 400) cho mot buoc, nut Luu van bam duoc nhung khi luu se hien mot thong bao loi ky thuat kho hieu thay vi loi nhac ro rang la ngay vuot gioi han.

title: Eval paths leave out the shared dialog shell (khung-tao.tsx), so edits to it will not mark E11/E14 evidence stale
plain: Neu sau nay ai do sua lai hop thoai dung chung hoac doi nhan loi, he thong nghiem thu tu dong co the khong nhan ra va van bao moi thu da qua kiem.

title: The Add broker button silently overwrites the source of an existing enrollment from nen-tang to tay
plain: Neu chon them mot nguoi vao ke hoach ma nguoi do da co mat trong pheu (duoc dong bo tu dong tu truoc), nguon ghi danh cua ho se am tham doi thanh 'them tay' ma khong co canh bao nao.

title: Lookup queries in the new dialogs show a failed load as an empty result
plain: Neu viec tai danh sach cong ty, khuon hoac chu so huu bi loi mang, nguoi dung chi thay o chon trong nhu khong co ket qua, khong co thong bao la da xay ra loi.

title: Shape 4 (negative assertion without a pinned message): the E9 and E8 failing directions do not fail with the case name the eval promises
plain: Neu ve sau nut bi an sai cho, bo kiem tu dong co the chi bao loi chung chung thay vi chi dung nguyen nhan, khien nguoi xem kho biet cho nao hong.

title: Shape 3 (string presence instead of a relation): ngay den han = startedAt + offsetDays is only checked on the step with offsetDays = 0
plain: Bai kiem tu dong hien chi chac chan ngay den han dung cho buoc khong co do tre; neu cach tinh ngay den han cho cac buoc co do tre bi sai, bo kiem co the khong phat hien ra.

title: Shape 5 (claims a class but checks only some cases): luu-hong promises 'tung o da nhap giu gia tri' but giu() samples only one or two fields per dialog
plain: Bo kiem tu dong hien chi xac nhan mot hoac hai o duoc giu lai sau khi luu hong; neu mot o khac trong cung hop thoai bi mat gia tri khi luu hong, nguoi dung co the gap loi ma khong co bai kiem nao bat duoc.
